protocol.functional_endpoint: valid controls; mass ratio0.75–1.25; motion ratio>=0.25; occupied<=0.03; shape secondary
protocol.functional_time: first3 consecutive completed rolling50-step motion windows meeting the functional endpoint
protocol.heldout_scope: excluded from this training objective; damage levels have historical exploratory exposure

acceptance.criterion: mean held-out recovery >=65%, >=25 points above canonical, and >=95% valid matched controls
